payload.title: S-1 · Let shoppers pick a display currency (web-storefront)
acceptance_criteria: The storefront accepts a display-currency choice and keeps it only if the currency is supported; otherwise it falls back to USD without failing the page.
Amounts are formatted with the currency's own minor-unit digits (two for EUR, zero for JPY).
No change to the orders-api client or to the order it decodes.

payload.thought_summary: Add a display-currency picker next to formatMoney; keep the orders client untouched.

payload.title: S-2 · Record the FX quote used at checkout (orders-service)
acceptance_criteria: POST /orders accepts an optional `fxQuoteId` (string, 1-64 characters); an invalid value is a 400.
The order stores it and `OrderPlaced` carries it when present.
The change is additive: no existing field of `OrderPlaced` or of `GET /orders/{id}` is renamed, removed or retyped.

payload.thought_summary: Additive only: optional fxQuoteId on the request, the order and OrderPlaced; no field renamed.

payload.title: S-3 · Authorize payments in the order's currency (payments-service)
acceptance_criteria: An authorization request carries the amount in minor units together with its ISO-4217 currency code.
A currency the payment provider does not support is declined with a typed reason, never converted silently.
`PaymentCaptured` keeps its existing fields; any new field is additive.

payload.title: S-4 · Invoice only in currencies Finance can settle (billing-service)
acceptance_criteria: Billing exposes the list of settlement currencies and the minor-unit digits of each one.
A currency outside that list raises a clear, typed error instead of defaulting to two decimals.
Zero-decimal currencies (JPY) are covered by tests.

payload.title: S-5 · Report revenue in one reporting currency (analytics-ingest)
acceptance_criteria: A conversion helper turns an amount in minor units of any supported currency into USD cents, using integer FX rates (parts per million); no floating-point amount is stored.
It respects each currency's minor-unit digits (JPY has none).
A currency without a rate is an error, not a zero.

payload.thought_summary: Integer FX rates in parts per million; scale by minor-unit digits so JPY converts correctly.

payload.title: S-6 · Reserve stock in the shopper's region (inventory-service)
acceptance_criteria: On `OrderPlaced`, the warehouse is chosen from the order currency (EUR: eu-central, GBP: uk-south, others: us-east).
`StockReserved` and `StockShortage` keep their existing fields; the warehouse is an additive field.
An unknown currency falls back to us-east and is logged, never dropped.
